name: dwarfii_api
description: wrapper for Dwarf II telescope API

scripts.CI: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck
scripts.copy-current: copyfiles src/protobuf/current.js src/protobuf/current.d.ts src/protobuf/current-fields.js src/protobuf/current-descriptor.json src/current_proto/* dist/
scripts.test: npm run ts && node src/__tests__/v3_camera_params.test.js && node src/__tests__/tele_mosaic.test.js && node src/__tests__/current_schema.test.js && node src/__tests__/current_session.test.js && node src/__tests__/current_catalog.test.js && node src/__tests__/current_websocket.test.js && node src/__tests__/current_capture.test.js
scripts.build: npm run generate-current && npm run compile-proto && npm run compile-protoJS && npm run CI && npm run ts && npm run generate-types && npm run copy-files && npm run generate-docs
